messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: unusual token-count surge for tenant `astra-labs-7` on Dedicated pool `dpool-eu-1b`. Multiple billing and quota alerts triggered. Pager ID: P-20260302-astra-token.

oncall-anya: I'm taking the page. Pulling up metrics and logs.

maya-eng: Any evidence of 429s or degraded latency for other tenants?

oncall-anya: Some client 429s reported within tenant, and a few downstream services reported quota.exhausted for that tenant only. No cross-tenant impact so far.

craig-sre: Looking at request samples. Seeing lots of odd byte patterns in the request body. Running tokenizer-sample now.

ops-bot: Auto-mitigation recommended: apply per-tenant soft-throttle (5rps) and enable server-side input truncation to 4096 tokens for tenant `astra-labs-7`. Reply with `approve mitigate` to proceed.

emily-cs: I'll ping Astra Labs to alert them we'll be applying temporary safeguards.

oncall-anya: Approve mitigate. ops-bot, throttle and enable truncation.

ops-bot: Executing: `POST /admin/tenants/astra-labs-7/actions/throttle` payload `{rate:5}` -> queued.

ops-bot: Throttle applied. Inbound rate for tenant decreased by ~70%.

eng-runtime: Sample log entry (sanitized): ```
{"req_id":"r_9a4b","input_bytes":"\u00ff\u00feA\u0000s\u0000t\u0000r\u0000a\u0000 \u0000-\u0000 \u0000payload\u0000...\u0000\u0000\u0000","token_count_reported":6,"token_count_actual":212345}
```

maya-eng: That looks like UTF-16LE with BOM (0xff 0xfe) and a lot of embedded nulls. Our tokenizer pretokenizer treats those nulls as separate tokenization delimiters leading to enormous token counts.

oncall-anya: Is this isolated to astra-labs-7?

eng-runtime: Yes; traffic is pinned to dpool-eu-1b and only that tenant is showing the spike.

ops-bot: Billing alert: projected overrun at current rate is ~9.4k USD/hour. billing-bot recommends creating billing ticket and proposing provisional credit.

emily-cs: Notifying Astra Labs tech contact now. Asked if they deployed a new SDK or changed client encoding.

postmortem-owner: Logging timeline start: page received at `1813567890`. Documenting actions here.

maya-eng: Proposed immediate fixes: (1) enable server-side UTF normalization and strip/convert UTF-16 to UTF-8 before tokenization, (2) enforce max_input_tokens=4096 for the tenant, (3) short-term tokenization_override to `gpt2` to collapse non-printables. Any objections?

oncall-anya: No objections; proceed with 1+2+3. After mitigations verify with observability.

eng-runtime: Applying config change: ```patch
PATCH /v1/admin/tenants/astra-labs-7/config
{
  "input_encoding_normalize": "auto-utf8-convert",
  "tokenizer_override": "gpt2",
  "max_input_tokens": 4096
}
```

eng-runtime: Patch rolled out to 6/6 nodes in dpool-eu-1b.

ops-bot: Config rollout success. 95th pct token-count for tenant dropped by 99%. No further quota.exhausted events.

emily-cs: Astra Labs replied: "We shipped v2 of our mobile SDK last night which now sends UTF-16 payloads to save bytes in some languages. We'll revert and roll a proper UTF-8 encoding fix. ETA 4h." They asked for an incident summary and billing help.

billing-bot: Opened billing ticket BT-3490. Proposed provisional cap: bill to baseline usage up to 03:00 UTC + 0 for anomaly window; flagged for finance approval.

postmortem-owner: Assigning follow-ups: (a) eng-runtime to harden input normalization and add a unit test covering UTF-16 BOM + null-byte collapse (owner: maya-eng), (b) product to add per-tenant emergency billing caps/auto-notice (owner: postmortem-owner), (c) cs to coordinate credits and send customer-facing timeline (owner: emily-cs), (d) finance review billing ticket (owner: billing-bot).

maya-eng: I'll open PR with normalization + regression tests. Also adding an early-warning alert for token-count derivative spikes for tenants.

billing-bot: Finance approved provisional credit for the anomaly window pending final invoice adjustments. Updated BT-3490 with approval.

oncall-anya: Handing incident over to day SRE. Craig, you're on for 08:00-16:00. Please pick up postmortem and follow-ups.

craig-sre: Taking over. Confirming mitigations stable. I'll assemble the incident metrics and attach to postmortem.

postmortem-owner: ETA for draft postmortem: 72 hours. Will include timeline, root cause analysis (client UTF-16 payloads), technical fix plan, and customer credit decision.

emily-cs: Sent customer note: "We've applied server-side normalization and temporary throttles to prevent further inflated tokenization. Please revert the client SDK to UTF-8 and we'll coordinate a follow-up test window." Astra Labs acknowledged.

oncall-anya: Good work. Closing pager. If regression occurs, re-open with pager. :white_check_mark:

inc-bot: PAGER CLOSED: P-20260302-astra-token. Reason: mitigations applied and token rates normalized.

postmortem-owner: Added action items to incident board and tagged owners. Will link postmortem here when ready.

craig-sre: Saved artifacts: request samples and tokenizer-diff output in `/mnt/artifacts/incidents/P-20260302-astra-token/`.

emily-cs: Following up with Astra Labs tomorrow for a joint verification.

maya-eng: After-action items: add a normalization stage pre-tokenizer and a tenant-level token spike early-warning. Filing ticket ENG-6287.

postmortem-owner: Closing thread in 4 hours unless new activity.
